# superset_database_catalogs (Data Source)

Lists the catalogs Superset sees in a database connection, on Superset 6, for engines with several catalogs such as PostgreSQL databases or Trino catalogs, for example to list the schemas of each of them with `superset_database_schemas`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_database_catalogs" "warehouse" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
}

# The schemas of every catalog of the connection.
data "superset_database_schemas" "per_catalog" {
  for_each = toset(data.superset_database_catalogs.warehouse.catalogs)

  database_name = "Warehouse"
  catalog       = each.key
}

output "schemas_per_catalog" {
  value = { for catalog, schemas in data.superset_database_schemas.per_catalog : catalog => schemas.schemas }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Whether Superset reads the catalogs from the database instead of its cache. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `catalogs` (List of String) Names of the catalogs, sorted.
- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection.
